def tabu_search(a, iters):
    """Best-improvement single flips with a tabu list; det ratios come from the inverse."""
    a = a.astype(float)
    inv = np.linalg.inv(a)
    logdet = np.linalg.slogdet(a)[1]
    top, top_logdet = a.copy(), logdet
    tabu = np.zeros((N, N), dtype=int)
    for it in range(1, iters + 1):
        gains = np.log(np.abs(1.0 - 2.0 * a * inv.T) + 1e-300)
        allowed = (tabu < it) | (logdet + gains > top_logdet + 1e-9)
        gains = np.where(allowed, gains, -np.inf)
        i, j = np.unravel_index(np.argmax(gains), gains.shape)
        ratio = 1.0 - 2.0 * a[i, j] * inv[j, i]
        inv -= np.outer(inv[:, i], inv[j, :]) * (-2.0 * a[i, j]) / ratio
        a[i, j] *= -1
        logdet += gains[i, j]
        tabu[i, j] = it + TABU_TENURE
        if logdet > top_logdet + 1e-9:
            top, top_logdet = a.copy(), logdet
    return top.astype(int)
